P0_scene_reproduction_control.why: an A/B against a committed frame is worth nothing if the scene moved; this is F48's own control discipline
P0_scene_reproduction_control.if_it_fails: the dwell scene is NOT F48's base scene; say so and treat every comparison against 11.164(c) as suspect rather than reinterpreting the numbers

P1_series_shapes.H_never_lands: disc_mean[0] in [55,70]; flat; no body-texture event inside the dwell window
P1_series_shapes.H_lands_late: at least one UPWARD step, final level > 120, and a Moon-texture applog event bracketed between the two screenshot echoes that straddle the step
P1_series_shapes.H_shading_changed: disc_mean[0] in [55,70]; flat; any texture event in the window uncorrelated with any step
P1_series_shapes.DEGENERACY_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN: H_never_lands and H_shading_changed make the SAME series prediction. The series alone cannot separate them; what it CAN do is refute a minutes-late upload. Separating the two survivors is P2 (no launch) and P3 (same launch).
P1_series_shapes.WINDOW_LIMIT_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN: the three Moon texture events are logged before the first TCP command, so the dwell window opens ~60 s after they fire. This run cannot see a step that happened during startup. What would: a sampler running from the first drawn frame - named here, not run.
P1_series_shapes.my_own_bet: FLAT and dim (F48 already measured two frames 10 s apart agreeing to 0.01 in disc mean, in both epochs). Recorded so the entry can be held to it.

P2_frame_pair_discriminator_no_launch.what: f51_disc.py --pair JULY TODAY on the two committed frames (artifacts/b3_ladder/R6_moon_terrain_control/terrain_base_zoom.png and artifacts/f48/ladder_current/terrain_base_zoom.png), geometry bit-identical by 11.164(c)
P2_frame_pair_discriminator_no_launch.why_hf_is_the_discriminating_statistic: a smooth tone map g sends the high-frequency part hf -> g'(L)*hf, so it PRESERVES the fine pattern up to a local scale; a frame whose albedo content never arrived has no reason to carry the same fine pattern at all. r_L alone is weak: the large-scale shading is common to both hypotheses.
P2_frame_pair_discriminator_no_launch.albedo_present_tone_changed: r_hf >= 0.7 with positive slope < 1, AND r2_pointwise_median_map >= 0.8
P2_frame_pair_discriminator_no_launch.otherwise: NEITHER - record as-is with the numbers, keep both readings, name what discriminates next

P3_old_path_control_same_launch.what: `flag experimental_path off` -> frames at FOV 10 and FOV 60 -> +10 s -> `flag experimental_path on` -> frame (A/B/A)
P3_old_path_control_same_launch.positive_control: the old-path FOV-10 frame must carry >= 100000 px with L>8 inside the mask. If it does not (the old path's observer need not sit where the new path's camera does), the leg is INCONCLUSIVE and is read as evidence in NO direction.
P3_old_path_control_same_launch.albedo_absent_predicts: the old path is albedo-less too: its hf_mean <= 3.0 and r_hf vs the JULY frame <= 0.2
P3_old_path_control_same_launch.albedo_present_predicts: the old path carries albedo: hf_mean >= 5.0 and r_hf vs the JULY frame >= 0.5 (a weaker bar than P2 - the two paths are not the same shader and need not be pixel-aligned)
P3_old_path_control_same_launch.ABA_control: the new-path frame after toggling back must return to within 1.0 disc_mean of the dwell level, else the toggle perturbed the scene and P3 is inconclusive
P3_old_path_control_same_launch.bonus_observable: if the toggle re-requests textures, new `creating uninitialized texture` events appear in the applog INSIDE the window, bracketed by named samples - that is a second, live look at the branch
